task_facts.overview:
# Macro placement: bboplace_bigblue2_n32

Minimize HPWL for a fixed 32-macro placement task. The 64 coordinates x_0 through x_31 and y_0 through y_31 refer to the same ordered macro list. Coordinates lie in [0,224] on a 224 by 224 grid.

Budget: 50 shared initial observations and 200 new evaluations (250 total).
task_facts.scoring: Inputs are floored to the grid. A deterministic geometry-only repair places larger-area macros first, breaking equal-area ties by their original index. Legal positions are retained; conflicts move to the nearest legal position in physical Manhattan distance, with x/y lexicographic ties. The repair reads no netlist or wire cost. HPWL is calculated on the complete repaired layout. If repair cannot finish, the host returns the fixed worst-HPWL legal shared-initial layout and its HPWL. Every submission uses one evaluation, including fallback.
task_facts.domain_knowledge: Both axes belong to the same macros. Floor quantization can make sub-cell changes equivalent. Coordinate interactions arise from non-overlap constraints and connected pins; repairing an early macro can displace later ones. Smaller wire bounding boxes reduce HPWL, but clustering can require repair. Changes to a few macros and varied alternative layouts can test these effects using evaluated history.
task_facts.submission: Provide one complete legal configuration using the declared coordinates. Only the host returns objective observations.
